title: Tim and the Big Box
lines: "Can I have the big box?" said Tim.
"Yes," said Dad. "It can be a cat den."
Tim set the box on the rug.
"Get in, cat," said Tim. But it did not.
It sat on top. Tim was sad.
He set it in the box.
The cat hops in and naps on the hat.
"You did it, Tim," said Dad. Tim nods.

questions.ask: What did Tim want the big box to be?
questions.listenFor: A den for the cat. Line two says it. If your child is stuck, let them reread that line.

questions.ask: What did Tim put in the box to get the cat to go in?
questions.listenFor: His red hat. Lines six and seven say it. One word is plenty.

questions.ask: Why do you think the hat worked when asking did not? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Their own thinking. Soft, warm, or it smelled of Tim are all good. The story never says, which is why this one belongs to them.
